title: kith-peer: outbox_tick receipt handling + build_peer_receipt_request
description:
Extend outbox_tick to detect kind='receipt' entries and deliver them as Peer/receipt JMAP calls.

**What:** Add build_peer_receipt_request() and dispatch receipt entries in outbox_tick.

**Algorithm:**
1. In crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs, add:
   pub fn build_peer_receipt_request(message_id: &str, kind: &str, at: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
       serde_json::json!({
           "using": ["urn:ietf:params:jmap:core", "urn:kith:chat:1"],
           "methodCalls": [[
               "Peer/receipt",
               {
                   "accountId": "a-self",
                   "messageId": message_id,
                   "kind": kind,
                   "at": at
               },
               "0"
           ]]
       })
   }
   where kind is "read" (always for this feature; receipts are enqueued by process_update on readAt), and at is the RFC 3339 formatted read_at_unix timestamp.

2. In outbox_tick, where it currently calls build_peer_deliver_request for each entry, add a branch:
   - Load message if entry.kind == 'receipt': ONLY need to format read_at_unix as RFC 3339 timestamp. No need to load message body/attachments. Message_id from entry is sufficient.
   - Compute at = chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp(read_at_unix, 0).format RFC 3339 UTC.
   - If read_at_unix is None: call record_failure (malformed receipt row, skip).
   - Build receipt request: build_peer_receipt_request(&entry.message_id, "read", &at_str)
   - Deliver to entry.peer_mailbox_host via existing deliver_client.
   - On success: call outbox.complete_delivery(&entry, now_unix_at_success) — this deletes the receipt outbox row (no message state update because entry.kind == 'receipt').
   - On failure: call outbox.record_failure(&entry, error_str, now_unix) — same retry logic as messages.

3. Update existing outbox_tick calls to record_failure, complete_delivery, mark_failed, mark_delivered to use the new &OutboxEntry signatures (from Z9LY.2).

4. Update outbox_tick calls where message lookup returns None: currently calls mark_delivered(message_id) — update to mark_delivered(&entry).

**Defensive programming rules:**
- read_at_unix None for a receipt row: call record_failure (do not panic or silently skip).
- Timestamp formatting must produce RFC 3339 UTC with Z suffix (consistent with rest of kith).
- Delivery client call for receipts uses the SAME https client as messages — no special trust.
- No logging of message body in receipt path.

**Agent team:** R (read outbox_tick, build_peer_deliver_request) + I.

**Tests:** cargo test -p kith-peer must pass clean.
